# Norm Sandberg for Mayor of Collingwood

> Official campaign website for Norm Sandberg, candidate for Mayor of Collingwood, Ontario (municipal election October 26, 2026).

Primary site: https://normformayor.ca/
Secondary domain: https://norm4mayor.ca (redirects to primary)
Contact email: norm@norm4mayor.ca
Phone: 705-445-8384
Location: Collingwood, Ontario, Canada

## Candidate

- Name: Norm Sandberg (also known as Norman Sandberg)
- Office sought: Mayor of the Town of Collingwood
- Election date: October 26, 2026
- Background: Long-time Collingwood resident; multiple terms on Collingwood Council; municipal leadership and engineering experience
